snippet.title: Targeted email marketing: Send the right message to the right person
snippet.description:
Generic, send-to-everyone emails get ignored and never reach the inbox that matters. Targeted email marketing changes that by delivering the right message, to the right person, at the right time.

In this short guide, you'll learn how to:
• Segment your audience by interests, habits, and demographics
• Personalize emails so customers don't feel like a row in a database
• Write subject lines that actually earn the open
• Reach the right moment (ex. new homeowners before spring cleanup, shoppers right before Mother's Day)
• Close with one clear call to action
• A/B test and keep optimizing for higher engagement and ROI

The payoff: sharper insights, more conversions, and readers who look forward to hearing from you.

snippet.title: How to sync email and SMS on Mailchimp 📲
snippet.description:
Email consent and SMS consent are treated as completely separate in Mailchimp, so being subscribed to one doesn't mean you can text the other. 

This video covers what to know before syncing both channels:

• SMS consent requires expressed, verifiable permission before sending anything
• Prepare your spreadsheet, then upload it as a CSV or TXT file
• Email imports need an email address column; SMS imports need an E.164-formatted number
• Set email and SMS marketing status separately during import

#Mailchimp

snippet.title: How to segment your email list for higher conversions
snippet.description:
Segmented campaigns can drive 2x more clicks than sending the same email to your entire list.

Treating your subscribers like individuals is the secret to a crowded inbox that actually converts. In this video, we break down the most effective ways to segment your audience and get smarter targeting results.

Here are the top ways to divide your list:

• Behavioral segmentation based on recent purchases or abandoned carts
• Location targeting by country, city, or time zone for regional offers
• Demographics like age, gender, and income to start with what you know
• Email engagement metrics like open rates and click-through rates

Mailchimp gives you pre-built segments based on purchase behavior and engagement, so you can start sending targeted campaigns without building everything from scratch.  Learn more: https://intuit.me/4ofXTI6

localized.title: What are the benefits of SMS marketing?
localized.description:
Did you know that SMS open rates sit around 98%?

A well-planned SMS marketing strategy can strengthen customer relationships, boost conversions, and work alongside your other channels to create a more complete marketing experience. Let's break down why SMS marketing is one of the most powerful tools for growing your business:

1. Immediate reach allows messages to be delivered almost instantly and read within minutes.
2. High open rates ensure faster customer conversions for time-sensitive updates.
3. Direct action is built around one clear call to action within a focused character limit.
4. Lean channel cost means no design costs, print fees, or additional ad spend.
5. Qualified audience ensures you reach contacts who have explicitly opted in.

snippet.title: Como evitar filtros de spam
snippet.description:
Já se perguntou por que seus e-mails importantes acabam na pasta de spam? Este vídeo explica o que é spam e os requisitos legais para marketing por e-mail nos EUA, Canadá e União Europeia.

Esses requisitos incluem obter consentimento explícito, fornecer um link para cancelamento de inscrição e manter os assuntos dos e-mails claros e objetivos. Também abordamos como filtros de spam sofisticados avaliam suas mensagens, com foco em fatores-chave como reputação do remetente, engajamento, higiene da lista e o papel dos firewalls e da interação com o assinante.

Aprenda dicas essenciais: sempre peça permissão, envie conteúdo relevante e mantenha os assuntos dos seus e-mails claros e objetivos para garantir que seus e-mails cheguem à caixa de entrada e não à pasta de spam.

Estos requisitos incluyen obtener un consentimiento claro, proporcionar un enlace de cancelación de suscripción y mantener asuntos honestos. También explicamos cómo los sofisticados filtros de spam evalúan tus mensajes, centrándonos en factores clave como la reputación del remitente, la interacción, la higiene de la lista y la función de los firewalls y la interacción con los suscriptores.

Aprende los consejos esenciales: siempre pide permiso, envía contenido relevante y mantén tus asuntos limpios para asegurarte de que tus correos lleguen siempre a la bandeja de entrada, no a la carpeta de spam.

snippet.title: How Two-Way SMS Drives Real Results
snippet.description:
What if your marketing didn’t just talk at customers, but actually talked with them?

In this video, we dive into the power of Two-Way SMS and how it transforms simple notifications into meaningful customer conversations.
Most businesses stop at delivery, but the real magic happens when your customers can text you back.

Whether it’s confirming an appointment, answering a survey, or providing real-time support, two-way texting builds the kind of trust that standard email or one-way blasts simply can't match.

snippet.title: The Marketing Equalizer: Leveraging AI for Mid-Market Growth
snippet.description:
What does effective, modern marketing look like for mid-market teams today?

In this on-demand webinar, Intuit Mailchimp and WARC share insights from a global study of 1,205 marketers across the US, UK, Canada, and Australia/New Zealand. The research benchmarks how mid-market organizations with 10–500 employees are structuring their teams, investing their budgets, and putting AI to work to drive real business results.

Mid-market marketers are balancing big ambitions with lean teams, limited budgets, and growing pressure to deliver impact. AI holds enormous promise—but only if teams have the confidence and capability to use it well. This session breaks down what sophisticated marketers are doing differently and how you can apply those learnings to your own organization.

Download our research report with WARC "The Marketing Equalizer: Leveraging AI for Mid-Market Growth": https://mailchimp.com/resources/the-marketing-equalizer/

Watch to learn how to:

• Benchmark your team structure and technology stack against more than 1,200 mid-market peers
• See where leading marketers are investing to maximize ROI
• Close capability gaps by positioning AI as a core business solution
• Apply practical guidance to overcome operational challenges and support global growth

Whether you’re just getting started with AI or looking to sharpen an existing strategy, this webinar offers clear, actionable insights to help your team work smarter, move faster, and grow with confidence.

snippet.title: RCS vs. SMS: Which Messaging Protocol is Right for You?
snippet.description:
Texting customers is easy, but should you use SMS or RCS?

This video explains the differences between these two messaging protocols and their pros and cons for business communication. SMS offers universal compatibility, guaranteed delivery, and simplicity, making it ideal for essential updates like order confirmations.

RCS provides advanced features like read receipts and rich media but works only on supported devices. Learn how to pick the right protocol based on your audience and goals to deliver customer messages that stand out while meeting their needs.

Learn more about RCS vs. SMS: https://mailchimp.com/resources/rcs-vs-sms/

snippet.title: Is The Holiday Season Really Year-Round?
snippet.description:
The holiday season used to have a neat little timeline. Now? It’s basically a year-long feeling, not a date on the calendar.

Ditch the old timeline. Annie-Mai Hodge is here to highlight the key findings from the latest Intuit Mailchimp report, revealing the emotional drivers behind consumer spending.

The data doesn’t lie:
- The Early Bird: 43% of shoppers made a purchase in October, long before the traditional “holiday mode” starts.
- The Final Rush: 76% buy something during the mid-December last-minute sprint when urgency (and stress!) peaks.
- The Post-Game: 70% keep shopping into the January sales, fueled by that “new year, new me” energy.

The takeaway for marketers? It’s not about the season’s start or end date—it’s about understanding when the feelings kick in and learning how to meet people in those specific moments.

We’ve done the deep dive so you don’t have to. https://bit.ly/48FF6Qu

snippet.title: Video File Too Big to Email? 3 Easy Fixes for Marketers
snippet.description:

Plus, learn how to use Mailchimp's video content block to embed a professional, light-weight thumbnail directly in your email, letting viewers watch the video without the hassle of large attachments. 

Sharing your work is simple, fast, and professional with the right tools.

snippet.title: Now available: The New E-Commerce Calendar
snippet.description:
Shoppers are fatigued with the amount of sales and promotions throughout the year, and finding the right times to connect with your customers is more important than ever.

We surveyed shoppers in 9 markets around the world and paired the results with advice from 6 experts to create The New E-Commerce Calendar: A Global Guide to Year-Round Shopper Engagement. 🌏

In it, you’ll find your 4-step strategic checklist to help make the most of every Moment throughout the year:

1. Open the Directory of Moments - Get an overall view of all that a single calendar year has to offer marketers, and treat it like a menu of opportunities.

2. Chart Shopper Opportunities - Learn about the 6 types of calendar Moments throughout the year in categories like Advocacy Moments, Entertainment Moments, and Holiday Moments.

3. Dial in to Brand Values - Choose the right Moments to align to your brand and your shoppers’ habits.

4. Mark Your Moments - Use our 4 strategic takeaways to engage at the right time, for the right reasons. 


Get the full report here: https://bit.ly/4dln8TO

snippet.title: The Latest Mailchimp Updates
snippet.description:
Our latest updates are here to help you save time and increase your bottom line — just in time for the busy holiday shopping season. 

Get a leg-up on the busiest e-commerce event of the year with the help of AI-powered Revenue Intelligence features. Generate a multi-touchpoint Black Friday Cyber Monday campaign that uses data to suggest timing and topics for each message, and make the most of each customer interaction with pre-built, AI-optimized customer journeys tailored to your business.   
Revenue intelligence features are available in a beta version and on a limited basis to certain users. This information is intended to outline our general product direction, but represents no obligation and should not be relied on in making a purchasing decision. Additional terms, conditions and fees may apply with certain features and functionality. Eligibility criteria may apply. Product offers, features, functionality are subject to change without notice.
SMS is available as an add-on to US, UK, Canada, or Australia paid plans only. Application and agreement to terms is required before purchasing credits. Messages can only be delivered to contacts in the country selected. Australia messaging available only for contacts with +61 country code. SMS credits are added to your account after purchase and approval. Credits are issued monthly and unused credits expire and do not roll over. MMS only available for Standard and Premium plans sending to US or Canada contacts. Pricing varies. See terms for details.

snippet.title: What makes a good marketer a good marketer?
snippet.description:
At its base level, the goal of marketing is to get people to act. In order to do that, marketers need to understand who people are at their core.

Culture is the most influential external force to human behavior, according to Dr. Marcus Collins, award-winning marketer and cultural translator. On Subcultural, Dr. Collins speaks to cultural subscriptions and how marketers can tap into this power. 

Subcultural is a podcast that explores culture on the fringes, where marketers can learn about the motivations and human nature behind these communities.

Catch up on the first 10 episodes here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLniTESH_YLMU4SR3dso-3G5AGSgr3Ja0H

snippet.title: Connect Your @WooCommerce Store and Set Up Automations in Mailchimp
snippet.description:
Are you looking to take your e-commerce business to the next level with powerful email marketing? Look no further than Mailchimp's integration with WooCommerce! In this video, we'll show you how to connect your Mailchimp account to your WooCommerce store in order to automate your email marketing efforts.

snippet.title: From the stadium to the stands: all about Olympic superfans
snippet.description:
Olympic athletes might perform superhuman feats—but Olympic superfans give the Games an atmosphere of shared humanity. 

Meet die-hard superfan Rachel Tobias, who travels globally to immerse herself in the Games, trade pins, and meet other spectators.

This episode on the Subcultural podcast invites you into the Olympics fandom community. Learn what the Games mean to superfans and how marketers can contribute to these international moments of camaraderie. 

Subcultural is a podcast that explores culture on the fringes, in an effort to learn from these communities, develop a deeper understanding of the people within them, and connect in an authentic way. 

Full episode here: https://youtu.be/otlrWulUo_c?si=sQ-G98vizg1AH3qs

snippet.title: Email is Dead | the Design Museum and Intuit Mailchimp Exhibit
snippet.description:
Email is personal and professional, pivotal and ubiquitous. And now you can hear from some of the creative minds behind Email is D̶e̶a̶d̶. 

The Design Museum’s exhibit, Email is Dead, brought to you by Intuit Mailchimp invites visitors to consider the look, feel, sound, and even the smell of email.

This free, interactive exhibition brought to you by Intuit Mailchimp’s in-house creative agency, Wink, and designed in partnership with creative studio Something Special Studios, examines how email’s impact goes far beyond simply a way to communicate. The exhibition explores how email helps shape our work lives, relationships, cultures and economies. Email is Dead is an immersive experience designed to prompt wider conversations about the future of communication and attempts to capture a 360-view of the feelings and sensations that email evokes.

Learn more: https://mailchimp.com/newsroom/email-is-dead-opens/

snippet.title: How to Use Email and SMS Together in Mailchimp
snippet.description:
When you use both email and SMS marketing in Mailchimp, you can execute powerful, personalized campaigns. When you coordinate SMS and Email together, you can get a clearer picture of who your customers are by gathering cross-channel insights that help you form complete contact profiles. With this unified data, you can guide your customers through personalized pathways to nurture their loyalty through high-engagement marketing campaigns. In this video, we'll take a look at the benefits of combining SMS and email marketing, powerful automations you don’t want to miss, and reporting that can help you prove the impact of your KPIs. 

*SMS is now available to US and UK customers.

snippet.title: Comment utiliser l'analyse comparative de campagne par e-mail de Mailchimp
snippet.description:
Dans cette vidéo, nous allons vous présenter l'analyse comparative de campagne de Mailchimp. Celle-ci vous permettra de mieux comprendre ce qui fonctionne dans votre marketing par e-mail, et ce que vous pouvez améliorer.

Dans Mailchimp, l'analyse comparative de campagne utilise la science des données pour comparer les performances de vos e-mails à celles de vos pairs. En effet, chaque jour, des centaines de millions d'e-mails sont envoyés avec Mailchimp, puis analysés afin de déterminer les moyennes des taux d'ouvertures, taux de clics et désabonnements. 

Ces données servent ensuite à développer des analyses personnalisées, à destination des utilisateurs dont le secteur d'activité et l'audience partagent certaines caractéristiques.

MovingWaldo is a Quebec company that helps customers organize their moving experience. Through their platform, you can book movers, change your address, secure a new internet package for your move-in day, and more.

Using a combination of automations, integrations, and A/B testing, MovingWaldo has grown its business across Quebec, and is now looking to expand into new markets.

snippet.title: Come utilizzare il benchmarking per le campagne email di Mailchimp
snippet.description:

In Mailchimp, la funzione di benchmarking delle campagne utilizza la data science di livello avanzato per confrontare le prestazioni delle email con quelle dei colleghi. Centinaia di milioni di email vengono inviate ogni giorno in Mailchimp. Vengono analizzate per determinare la percentuale media di aperture, la percentuale di clic e di cancellazione delle iscrizioni. 

Questi dati vengono quindi utilizzati per sviluppare benchmark personalizzati per gli utenti che condividono determinate caratteristiche di settore e di pubblico.

Che tu stia offrendo servizi individuali o di gruppo, lo strumento di pianificazione degli appuntamenti di Mailchimp è la soluzione perfetta per semplificare le prenotazioni dei tuoi clienti.

snippet.title: Crear un formulario de suscripción alojado en Mailchimp
snippet.description:
¿Estás preparado para que tu público crezca? En este vídeo, aprenderás a crear un formulario de suscripción para tu público utilizando el formulario de suscripción alojado de Mailchimp.  

El formulario de suscripción alojado de Mailchimp es una forma estupenda de crear rápida y fácilmente un formulario para tu público. Con la opción de creador de formularios, puedes personalizar tu formulario de suscripción añadiendo varios campos y definiendo campos obligatorios para que los suscriptores los rellenen antes de enviar el formulario. También puedes añadir valores por defecto para que aparezcan cuando los datos de un suscriptor no estén disponibles. Una vez que hayas terminado de personalizar el formulario, puedes añadir un mensaje de saludo y un resumen del vídeo para hacerlo más atractivo. Con este sencillo formulario de suscripción, podrás gestionar y hacer un seguimiento fácilmente de los nuevos suscriptores, además de mantenerles al día de tus últimas noticias y contenidos.

snippet.description:
Author and podcast host Nora McInerny wanted to make a difference in her stepchildren's lives but wasn’t quite sure what to expect from this new role. This week on Going Through It, she tells host Ashley C. Ford about her journey to creating a blended family, the importance of being flexible, and how much love is out there waiting for you in return.

snippet.description:

snippet.title: Conecte sua conta @salesforce no Mailchimp (2023)
snippet.description:
Neste vídeo, veremos como conectar o Mailchimp para Salesforce e sincronizar seus dados do Salesforce com sua conta do Mailchimp.

Ao conectar a integração do Salesforce, você pode mover rapidamente seus leads e contatos do Salesforce para o Mailchimp e direcioná-los com conteúdo de marketing especializado. A integração do Mailchimp para Salesforce é compatível com as versões Classic e Lightning do Salesforce. Hoje, mostrarei como instalar a versão clássica e escolher suas configurações de sincronização.
